csv_project_name: Cultural Resources and Section 106 Compliance Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Nevada City has applied for funding through the Land and Water Conservation Fund (LWCF) program administered by the California Department of Parks and Recreation Office of Grants and Local Services (OGALS). As a condition of grant funding, the project must comply with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act and associated federal regulations. The City is seeking proposals from qualified cultural resources consultants meeting the Secretary of the Interior s Professional Qualification Standards to complete all tasks necessary to support National Park Service (NPS), State Historic Preservation Officer (SHPO), and OGALS review and approval of Section 106 compliance documentation for the North Pine Pocket Park Project.
csv_disciplines_requested: Historic Preservation, Landscape Architecture, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Archaeology, Forestry
